resolved_findings.decision: Resolved. Reserved strip budgets, conditional gaps, body minimum and inset are accounted for, with constraints clamping. The gap-minimum and feasible nested BODY registration assertions remain green.

architecture_decisions: ContentSlot::owned is a justified additive component-author API with a concrete shell consumer. It boxes a CompositionLeaf with the caller data lifetime and does not require static data. No unsafe code, application dependency, new renderer, input dispatcher, or second layout engine was introduced.

Content is private, so adding the Owned variant does not break external exhaustive matching. Existing borrowed and nested constructors retain their signatures. Owned and borrowed variants share the same measurement, width remeasurement, resolved plans, clipping and draw flow; only trait-object access differs.

CompositionSlots iterative nested-group teardown remains intact. Non-group owned variants are dropped when the drained Content value is destroyed, exactly once. The independent non-static Unicode-label probe covers owned and borrowed leaves, zero regions, matching geometry/measurement counts and exact drop count.

ShellSlots is a Copy view configuration containing Chrome, Composition, and shared leaf references, not a second component-state owner. Owning this view in an outer composition preserves the old API without copying widget state.

The owned form adds one box per owned leaf and retains existing Vec allocation. Borrowed leaf storage remains allocation-free apart from its containing composition. AppShell::show still uses the borrowed canonical leaf path; no performance claim beyond source inspection is made.

PageLeaf uses a zero minimum and an additive draw_in default hook. Chrome remains the single resolver for shell strips, conditional gaps and body-only inset. Real registration/focus/cursor/hover probes exercise the shared resolved bounds.

landing_documentation_clarification.classification: Nonblocking architectural decision to record in the migration record before describing all compatibility as restored.
landing_documentation_clarification.detail: CompositionSlots::spec now configures the OUTER group containing the canonical shell leaf. Internal shell spacing remains Chrome::gap; an outer one-child spec.gap does not override the internal strip gaps. The old three-child representation leaked that internal override. Keep Chrome authoritative instead of restoring a duplicate engine, and document that consumers configure internal spacing with AppShell::gap/Chrome::gap. Existing docs example using outer .spec(gap1) should not imply an internal gap override. Type/lifetime compatibility is verified; every historical internal-layout side effect of generic spec is not claimed.

tests.inventory: 55 committed shell tests plus 2 immutable legacy compatibility probes and 2 independent measurement/registration probes. The nested registration probe changes only slots() to resolved_slots() because the latter is now the explicit leaf API; all assertions are unchanged.

Independent owned leaf borrows non-static String data containing wide and combining text. Compares owned/borrowed remeasurement counts and registered bounds, verifies measure does not draw or run App update, empty roots do not draw, and one leaf drops exactly once.
Includes borrowed-domain consumers, nested width reflow, shared clipping, zero size, excessive depth and safe tree drop.
